description: Use the person’s supplied numbers to calculate whether savings cover spending and compare one explicit retirement/spending alternative. Free, no sign-in. Returns annual results, assumptions, provenance and a portable input artifact; no saved-record lookup or mutation.

annualSpending.description: Annual household spending after tax in 2026 CAD, excluding contributions.

assumptionsAccepted.description: Confirm the stated basic scope, return/inflation assumptions and any explicit CPP estimate with the person before calculating.

birthDate.description: Exact birth date controls ages and benefit timing.

cppAnnualAt65.description: Annual CPP or QPP at 65 in 2026 CAD from statement. Explicit null accepts the labelled 60%-of-maximum starting estimate.

employmentIncome.description: Gross annual employment income now, CAD; enter 0 if none.

name.description: A label is enough; a legal name is unnecessary.

oasResidenceYears.description: Canadian residence years after 18 used for OAS entitlement at its start; 40 means full OAS.

annual.description: Annual pension in 2026 CAD; grown by plan inflation to its start age, then by its stated indexing.

quebecPayrollConfirmed.description: Required only for positive employment income in Quebec: explicitly confirm this employment is subject to Quebec payroll contributions. Residence alone does not establish the employment jurisdiction. Cross-province employment is outside this first-calculation scope.

name: calculate_retirement
title: Calculate a first Canadian retirement plan
